signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a Tudor-style house frontage from the street, partially obscured by a large tree trunk in the center but the house, lawn, and landscaping are visible.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Stone-edged mulch ring around the tree and planted foundation beds look tidy, but there are no crews, equipment, or other clear signs of professional service.

signals.notes: Well-kept Tudor-style home with a brick and stucco facade, tall chimney, blue arched front door, and mature landscaping; the neighboring house has a white picket fence and no activity is visible at the property.
